config sample:
```
  temporal:
    workers-auto-discovery:
      packages:
        - io.temporal.spring.boot.autoconfigure.bytaskqueue
```

- While all Activities are loaded as Beans, they depend on the boolean `workers-auto-discovery` 
- And then the filter for packages only applied Workflows. 

Essentially, if no `packages` are declared, then no Activities/Beans are registered either

## Expected Behavior
Activity beans to be loaded when
- `workers-auto-discovery` present in config despite the presence of `packages`

Preference to rename `packages` to `workflow-packages`

## Actual Behavior
No Activities registered, if no packages specified - [link](https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-java/blob/master/temporal-spring-boot-autoconfigure/src/main/java/io/temporal/spring/boot/autoconfigure/template/WorkersTemplate.java#L147-L152)

The issue doesn't _quite_ capture the issue at hand: One of the bugs is that activities are not component scanned for registration to a worker _unless_ `spring.temporal.workers-auto-discovery.packages` is non-empty.

The config is apparently meant to only be used for scanning for workflow implementations at these package roots, but activity auto-discovery registration is not activated unless this value is set. So, there are two potential solutions: (1) Always register `@ActivityImpl` beans with matching workers, or (2) introduce a flag (e.g. `spring.temporal.workers-auto-discovery.register-activities: true|false`) to control whether or not activity beans should be auto-registered.

My inclination would be that (2) is most-appropriate, as (1) seems like it could be backwards-incompatible.
Hi, Rob! Thank you for the extra details. We'll investigate.

Hey @robzienert. I'd be curious to have your opinion regarding #2830.

Short story, the PR:
- Deprecates the `packages` property.
- Add a `workflow-packages` property that only affects registration of workflows, without side effect on registration of activity and nexus operations.
- Add a `register-activities` and a `register-nexus-operations` properties.
- Add an `enable` property that provides an easy API to turn on registration of workflows, activities and nexus operations.

The PR preserves backward compatibility with the `packages` property.

Does that feel like an appropriate solution to your use cases?
